sources.title: Llama 3.2 | Model Cards and Prompt formats - developer.meta.com
sources.snippet: To initialize QAT, we utilize BF16 Llama 3.2 model checkpoints obtained after supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then perform an additional full round of SFT training with QAT. We then freeze the backbone of the QAT model and perform another round of SFT with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) adaptors applied to all layers within the transformer block.
